description: Lena owns a vintage photographic enlarger and must decide whether to accept an informal barter arrangement for it, then finalize the exchange and safe-use terms with the people gathered at a neighborhood photo-club gear swap.

shared_context.S1: Lena brought one vintage photographic enlarger to the neighborhood photo-club gear swap.
shared_context.S2: Lena will make the final call about whether to part with the enlarger and on what terms.
shared_context.S3: Omar, Felix, and June are all present because they have some connection to the enlarger or the proposed exchange.
shared_context.S4: At this gear swap, owners normally ask each participant in turn for any relevant offer, equipment-use concern, or comparison before closing an informal deal.

PF1.text: Omar's specific proposal is to take the enlarger in exchange for exactly three two-hour darkroom mentoring sessions, with no cash changing hands, and to collect it Saturday at 11:00.

PF2.text: Felix tested the enlarger and knows it needs a 120-volt, 75-watt bulb; Felix can lend Lena's eventual trading partner a 230-to-120-volt step-down transformer for the first month, but has not offered that arrangement to the group.

PF3.text: June is prepared to pay exactly $380 in cash for the enlarger and can collect it Saturday at 15:00; June has not yet stated this offer aloud.

acceptance_conditions: The enlarger must be traded to Omar.
The exchange must include exactly three two-hour darkroom mentoring sessions and no cash payment.
Pickup must be set for Saturday at 11:00.
The power arrangement must specify a 230-to-120-volt step-down transformer for the first month.
A transformer-loan commitment targeting Omar must be recorded.
The exact $380 cash alternative must be recorded for comparison.
Felix's electrical finding must be cited as justification for the power arrangement.
June's $380 cash offer must be cited as the comparison basis.

content_checks.C4: decisions['power_setup'] == '230-to-120-volt step-down transformer for first month'
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'transformer_loan' and c['target'] == 'Omar' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Omar's exact proposal changes the accepted partner to Omar, sets the exchange at exactly three mentoring sessions with zero cash, and fixes pickup at Saturday 11:00.
Felix's test changes the power term to a 230-to-120-volt transformer for the first month and creates the specific transformer-loan commitment that Lena must justify with Felix's spoken finding.
June's offer changes the comparison record from an unknown benchmark to exactly $380 cash and supplies the fact Lena must cite when evaluating Omar's barter.
